collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HUMOR AND ABSURDITY (HUM-01 to HUM-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Slapstick, silly noises, puns, pranks with permission, ridiculous coincidences, a little funny magic and animals being absurd. Nobody is the butt of the joke: everyone keeps their dignity, and the comedy needs no victim.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two adults)

collection.description: A villager talks in their sleep on turtle watch, haggling with a fish: join the negotiation, or tell them about it in the morning.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) and (friend) are sleeping out on the beach to watch for turtles coming ashore. (subject) talks in (subject.his/her) sleep. Tonight (subject.he/she) begins, very clearly, to negotiate with somebody. "No. Two coconuts. Not three. Two." (friend) lies awake listening. It seems to be a fish. It seems to be a difficult negotiation.

choices.label: Tell (subject.him/her) About It in the Morning

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) reports everything over breakfast. (subject) is embarrassed and fascinated. "Did I win?" "Hard to say. It went on for a long time." (subject) thinks about it all day. That night, on the beach again, (friend) hears (subject.him/her) say, quite clearly and with great reluctance, "Fine. Three."

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: "Three coconuts," whispers (friend). "Final offer." The sleeping (subject) considers this for a long time. "...Two and a mango." "Done," says (friend). (subject) sighs contentedly and starts to snore. In the morning (subject.he/she) remembers nothing at all, but wakes up looking extremely pleased with (subject.him/her)self.
